item.title: Colorado State Patrol says 4 killed in crash on I-25 near Pueblo involving at least 30 vehicles
item.description: CBS The Colorado State Patrol says four people were killed in a crash on I-25 south of Pueblo involving at least 30 vehicles on Tuesday morning. item.title: Boyd Buchanan Cruises to 83-53 Win in Region Quarterfinals
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Boyd Buchanan cruised into the region semifinals on Tuesday with an easy 83-53 win over Providence Academy. Bucs head coach Matt Hoppe was back on the bench for the first time since suffering a heart attack nearly a month ago. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
